evals.prompt: /zentao-init。当前目录是一个 Git 仓库，根目录还没有 .zentao。zentao CLI 已登录，可以访问多个产品和多个项目。请初始化当前项目。
evals.expected_output: Resolves the Git root, discovers saved CLI profile metadata through connection.mjs profiles, selects the server before products/projects when several servers exist, selects an account on that server, and pins its exact profile key for all helper-mediated reads. Presents objects as ID-and-name choices and confirms the final write. The version 2 file contains exactly schemaVersion, server, product, and project; no account or credential is persisted.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init 产品 6 项目 12。请把当前仓库关联到这两个禅道对象。
evals.expected_output: Selects or proposes a server from saved logins before validating product 6 and project 12 using the bound connection helper. Previews version 2 JSON including the normalized server URL, asks for final choice-based write confirmation, and preserves the global profile, workspace, credentials, and unrelated files.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init。仓库根目录已经有一个 .zentao，里面配置了产品 6 和项目 12。帮我检查一下配置是否还能用。 文件是 schemaVersion 2，server 为 https://a.example.com/zentao；存在这个服务的有效登录。
evals.expected_output: Validates the version 2 server/product/project contract, selects a matching saved login, and reads both objects through the helper pinned to the stored server. Leaves a valid matching mapping byte-for-byte unchanged and reports stale names or invalid objects accurately; never validates against a different current CLI server.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init。zentao profile --format=json 在 Codex 沙箱里返回 1005，说配置损坏或无法读取，但我已经在终端登录过了。
evals.expected_output: Does not confuse configstore error 1005 with missing authentication. Uses connection.mjs profiles, which copies the active CLI config opaquely into a private temporary directory and lets the CLI write only there. Continues if this succeeds. If the helper remains sandbox-blocked, retries only the same helper through the normal approval mechanism; persistent 1005 is reported as a config error without printing credentials or switching the global profile.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init。当前账号已经登录，zentao product --all --pick=id,name --format=json 成功返回 data: []，但账号可以访问多个项目。
evals.expected_output: Does not claim that an empty successful product response proves a permission problem and does not stop initialization. Offers choice-based options to continue without a product, retry, or cancel. If the user continues, sets product to null, presents accessible projects as ID-and-name choices, and previews a strict .zentao document with schemaVersion 2, the selected server, product null, and the selected project before requesting final write confirmation.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init。新仓库无 .zentao。CLI 保存了 dev@https://a.example.com 和 dev@https://b.example.com，当前是 B。两边都有项目 #9。请初始化 A 工程，但没有提供服务地址。
evals.expected_output: Does not infer server A from the repository name or choose global current B. Presents both full server URLs before any product/project reads, then uses the chosen server and exact key through the isolated helper. Includes server in the version 2 preview; never mutates global profile.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init。旧 .zentao 为 {"schemaVersion":1,"product":null,"project":{"id":9,"name":"项目"}}。CLI 当前登录 B，A 和 B 都有同名项目 #9。
evals.expected_output: Explains the missing server binding, asks to choose a server before remote validation, treats old IDs as candidates only, validates on the chosen service, previews the version 1 to 2 migration, and writes only after the final update choice. Does not stamp B onto the file automatically.

evals.prompt: /zentao-init 地址 https://new.example.com/zentao 产品 6 项目 12。CLI 只有 https://old.example.com 的登录。
evals.expected_output: Stops before product/project calls or writes, identifies new.example.com/zentao as the required service, asks for terminal login there, and does not use old.example.com or collect credentials.
